index.title: AI-gile: hoʻo kautaha AI faʻu polokalama, ʻi he laupapa pe taha
index.description: Ko e AI-gile ko ha laupapa kanban ia maʻa e ngaahi kautaha AI ʻoku nau tohi kouti. ʻOku nau ngāue lolotonga hoʻo mohe; te ke maʻu ha fanga kiʻi haʻanga nounou ʻo e ngaahi meʻa ke ke fili, sivi mo tali.
hero.h1.html: Hoʻo kautaha AI faʻu polokalama, ʻi he laupapa pe taha.
hero.alphaTitle: ʻOku teʻeki ke kakato: mālō hoʻo feinga!
hero.lede: ʻOku nau faʻu lolotonga hoʻo mohe. ʻE ke ʻā ʻo maʻu ha haʻanga nounou pe taha: ngaahi fehuʻi siʻi, ngaahi meʻa siʻi ke sivi, mo ha taimane violeti ʻe taha pe ua. Lomiʻi, tali, pea foki ki hoʻo kofi.
hero.secondary: Agile, ka ʻoku ʻikai fiemaʻu ʻe he kautaha ha kofi stand-up. (ʻOku nau fai pē stand-up.)
pitch.h2: AI-gile ʻi he ngaahi lea ʻe lahi ʻaki hoʻo loto
pitch.lede: Fili ha lōloa, mei he lea pe taha ki he 144. ʻOku taki taha ʻa e lōloa ko ha fakamatala makehe, naʻe tohi maʻa e lahi ko iá. Toho e slider pe ngāueʻaki e ngaahi ki ʻaro (arrow keys).
count.line.html.one: kaati ʻe {n} ʻi he laupapa he taimi ni
count.line.html.other: kaati ʻe {n} ʻi he laupapa he taimi ni
f.pile.html: Ko e Maʻau ʻoku ne tauhi ʻa e meʻa kotoa ʻoku tatali kiate koe, ʻi he poloseki kotoa: ngaahi fehuʻi, ngaahi meʻa ke sivi, ngaahi ngāue ʻoku faʻa fai pē ʻe he tangata. ʻOku fakahā ʻe hoʻo laine ʻa e meʻa hokó mo e taimi ʻe fie maʻu.
f.sleep.h: Ngaahi kautaha ʻoku ngāue lolotonga hoʻo mohe
f.sleep.p: Ko e poloseki kotoa pē ʻoku ʻi ai ha taki mo ha kautaha ʻo e ngaahi ʻeiseniti AI. Fakahā ha fakakaukau ʻi ha kaati pea ʻe ʻā ʻa e kautaha, fai e ngāue, pea ʻoatu ia mo e ngaahi sitepu ʻe lava ke muimui ai ha tangata ongosia.
f.tester.h: ʻOku sivi ʻuluaki ʻe he sivi AI
f.tester.p: Ki muʻa ke aʻu ha meʻa kiate koe, ʻoku muimui ʻa e sivi ʻi he ngaahi sitepu ʻi ha kopi ʻo e polokalama pea fakahā ʻa e meʻa naʻá ne sio ki ai, mo ha screenshot. Lau fakavave ʻa e ngaahi meʻa kuo pasi pea tali ʻaki ha lomiʻi pe taha.
f.proof.h: Fakamoʻoni, ʻikai ko e ngaahi talaʻofa
f.proof.p: Ko e tuku atu kotoa ʻoku fakahā ai ʻa e meʻa kuo liliu: ngaahi faile, kehekehe, mo e ngaahi screenshot. ʻIkai fiemaʻu ke fakaava ʻa e polokalama kotoa ke sio pe kuo kakato.
f.chat.p: Ko ha kolomu hangē ko e Discord: ko e fakaʻilonga pe taha ki he poloseki taki taha, taimane violeti maʻa e meʻa ʻoku fiemaʻu ai koe. Fekau ha fakakaukau ki ha taki; te ne liliu ia ki he ngaahi kaati mo ha palani, mo ha pātani ✅ Ō.
f.tidy.h: ʻOku tauhi ʻe ia ʻa ia ke lelei
f.tidy.p: Ko e ngaahi kaati fekauʻaki ʻoku fakataha ʻo hoko ko e taha, ko e ngaahi ʻulu hala ʻoku fakatonutonu, pea ʻoku tauhi ʻe he sivi tokeni ʻa e kouti ke maʻama. Siʻi ange ʻa e ngaahi meʻa ke fetongi, siʻi ange ʻa e fakakaukau.
f.private.h: Ko hoʻo meʻa, ʻi hoʻo komipiuta
f.private.li1: ʻOku ngāue ʻa e laupapa ʻi hoʻo komipiuta pea tali pē kiate koe.
f.private.li2: Ko e ngaahi pōpoaki fakapulipuli ʻo e kakai ʻoku fakapulipuliʻi mei he ʻuluaki ki he ngataʻanga (end-to-end).
f.private.li3: ʻIkai ha akaunití, ʻikai ha toʻo fakaʻilonga, ʻikai ha kuki.
f.lang.p: Lea ʻe laka hake he 120, mei he lea faka-Hōlani, faka-Uēlesi mo faka-Siapani ki he kaniva, Yoda mo e Klingon, mo ha fetongi vave ki he lea fakapālangi maʻa e ngaahi lea faʻu polokalama.
tl.aria: Laine ʻo e taimi mei he talanoa ʻuluaki ki he palani
tl.h2: Mei he talanoa ʻuluaki ki he meʻa hoko mai
tl.lede: Ngaahi ʻaho mo e taimi moʻoni, ʻi hoʻo feituʻu taimi. Hili e ʻahó ni ko e palani pē ia, ʻikai ha ʻaho kuo talaʻofa.
join.lede: ʻOku faʻu ʻa e AI-gile ʻe ha tangata siʻi mo ha ngaahi ʻeiseniti kātaki lahi. ʻOku fakapulipuli he taimi ni, ʻi ha alpha tāpuni mo e ngaahi kaungāmeʻa. Te ke loto ke ke feinga ʻo ka ava?
join.small: Te mau imeili atu, ʻikai ha toe meʻa
footer.tag: AI-gile. ʻIkai ha toʻo fakaʻilonga, ʻikai ha kuki, ʻikai ha kofi stand-up.

interest.title: AI-gile: fakamatala mai ʻo ka ava ʻa e alpha
interest.description: Tuku mai hoʻo imeili ke ke ʻilo ʻo ka ava ʻa e alpha tāpuni pe beta ʻa e AI-gile.
interest.lede: ʻOku ʻi he pre-alpha tāpuni ʻa e AI-gile. Tuku mai hoʻo imeili pea te mau tohi atu taha pē, ʻo ka ʻi ai ha potu maʻau.
interest.alpha: Alpha tāpuni: kei ʻuluaki, matolu, liliu lahi
interest.both: ʻIkai ha meʻa, ko ia ʻe hoko ʻuluaki
interest.thanks: Mālō! ʻOku ʻi he lisi koe.
interest.kept: Ko hoʻo imeili pē mo e sivi naʻá ke fili ʻoku tauhi, maʻa e lisi ni pē. ʻIkai ha nusipepa, ʻikai ha toʻo fakaʻilonga.
licence.title: AI-gile: laiseni pisinisi
licence.description: ʻOkú ke fakaʻaongaʻi ʻa e AI-gile ʻi hoʻo pisinisi? Kole ha laiseni pisinisi ʻikai ha totongi.
licence.lede: ʻOkú ke fakaʻaongaʻi ʻa e AI-gile ʻi he ngāue? Tala mai pe ko hai koe mo e meʻa ʻokú ke faí. Kapau ʻoku fai ha lelei, ʻikai ha totongi ʻa e laiseni.
licence.how: Founga ʻoku tokoni ai ki he māmani
licence.thanks: Mālō! Te mau tali ʻaki e imeili.
